title: Indians Make Strong Start at World Junior Championships, All Singles Advance
indian_angle: All eight Indian singles players won their opening matches, ensuring a flawless start for the country at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India achieved a perfect opening day at the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, with all eight singles players, including Tanvi and Shaina, securing victories and advancing to the next round.

title: Sindhu, Lakshya Face Challenging Openers at Denmark Open
indian_angle: Top Indian shuttlers PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen are set for difficult first-round encounters against formidable opponents at the Denmark Open.
summary: PV Sindhu is drawn against her rival An Se-young, while Lakshya Sen will take on Chou Tien Chen in their respective opening matches at the Denmark Open.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has officially established its new Athletes Committee, enhancing player representation in national badminton governance.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its Athletes Committee, a significant step towards greater athlete involvement in decision-making processes.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: Indian junior shuttlers are attending a national coaching camp in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing India's contingent for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is conducting an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course across two national centers to upskill Indian badminton coaches.
summary: The BAI is hosting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, running from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.
